_about: Scenario settings shared by GTFS/seattle_sumo_gtfsData_setup.ipynb (filter and bus gtfs2pt cells),
Loaded with scenario.py. Paths are relative to this file. To use another file, set the environment variable
SUMO_SCENARIO to its path. Best practice: change bus_feed and ridership_period together (same service period).
After changing anything here: rerun the notebook, then ridership_personflows.py (see the GTFS README).
name: FAL25_253
_bus_feed: KCM feed FAL25-159.1, valid 2025-09-08 to 2026-03-27 (Internet Archive copy from 2025-10-07)

_about: Link light rail. Read by the notebook's rail filter and rail gtfs2pt cells and ridership/rail_personflows.py.
Rail may use another period than the buses (the 2 Line has run through downtown only since 2026-03-28),
but its schedule and ridership should match each other.
rail._ridership_file: Sound Transit system performance tracker (Power BI), Link, Avg Boardings per Day, Weekday, Apr + May 2026, by station; read 2026-10-22
rail._time_of_day_share: ASSUMPTION: share of daily boardings in AM (05-09) and MID (09-15), taken from KCM bus ridership period 253 (all lines); Sound Transit publishes no time of day
